$comment: Generic lock-down policy template for a T3 Code v0.1.6 server run by a supervising connector. T3 Code has no managed-policy file of its own (see tailor/policy/README.md); install-policy.ps1 turns this template into machine environment variables, a read-only Claude settings file and an optional settings seed, and the connector launches 't3 serve' only with the 'serverEnvironment' below. No hostnames, paths, accounts or credentials belong in this file; machine-specific values are installer parameters. The build runs Claude only (TAILOR_CLAUDE_ONLY); disabledDrivers is no longer needed.

runtimeMode.$comment: Compiled into the server (TAILOR_MAX_RUNTIME_MODE, DEFAULT_RUNTIME_MODE): Supervised on every path. These values document it and cannot raise it; raising it needs the t3server/t3agent split (SECURITY-REVIEW.md, T3-42).

claudeInstance.$comment: The installer writes 'settings' to <Claude home>\settings.json, read-only to non-admins. The server reads it to cap the mode. The Claude binary loads no settings file at all (settingSources: []); its deny rules come from the policy tier compiled into the server (tailorClaudeManagedSettings), and are repeated here for reference.

environment.$comment: Set on the T3 provider instance (Settings > Providers > Claude > Environment), never machine-wide. Credential variables are entered there as sensitive values; see provider-config.md.

connectorToken.$comment: Issued by the 'T3 token issuer' task, which runs as t3agent with T3's own CLI against the T3 home every day, into %ProgramData%\T3CodePolicy\connector-drop (t3agent may create the file but not read, list or delete it). The 'T3 token mover' task (SYSTEM, fixed code) moves it into connector	oken with a t3bridge-only ACL set at creation. The issuer keeps the two newest connector sessions and revokes the rest. tailor:connector reaches only the five contract RPCs and five dispatch commands (RpcAuthorization.tailorConnectorAllows). install-policy.ps1 -ConnectorTokenDays sets the lifetime.

egress.$comment: Defaults for install-policy.ps1 -AllowedHosts. Override per machine.

bridge.$comment: The T3 bridge runs as t3bridge, opens no listener, and dials out only to loopback (T3) and the tailor.au API hosts given to install-policy.ps1 -TailorApiHosts (for example api.example.com). Its tailor.au key lives in %ProgramData%\T3CodePolicy\bridge, readable by t3bridge only.

workspaces.$comment: Projects must be inside a workspace root while the policy is installed (workspacePolicy.ts). The installer creates %ProgramData%\T3CodePolicy\workspaces for Administrators, SYSTEM and t3agent only; -WorkspaceRoots adds more. See README.md, 'Getting code in and out'.

gitHardening.$comment: Every git command T3 runs gets GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = an empty admin-owned file (%ProgramData%\T3CodePolicy\git-config\gitconfig), GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, core.hooksPath = the empty admin-owned git-hooks folder, safe.bareRepository=explicit, core.fsmonitor=false, protocol.ext.allow=never, protocol.file.allow=user, credential.helper= (cleared), core.sshCommand=ssh, commit.gpgSign=false and tag.gpgSign=false; diff, log, show, blame, diff-tree and stash show get --no-ext-diff --no-textconv (gitHardening.ts).
